column1: # service-registry.tsv — the DECLARATIVE SSOT of every supervised service.
# fleet/watchdog/ RENDERS monit config from this file (generate-monit-config.sh) and
# EVALUATES liveness from it (discover-services.sh). It is version-controlled CONFIG,
# not ephemeral runtime state, which is why `.gitignore` carries an explicit
# `!fleet/state/service-registry.tsv` negation past the blanket `fleet/state/*`.
# It had a negation but was NEVER COMMITTED: the GENERATED output (fleet/watchdog/monit.d/*.conf)
# was tracked while its SOURCE was not, so a fresh clone/CI checkout had a watchdog with no SSOT
# and fleet/tests/verify-restart-cmds.test.sh case 8 went RED on every PR. Reconstructed here from
# the committed monit.d stanzas; `generate-monit-config.sh --check` proves the round-trip.
# COLUMNS (TAB-separated, exactly 7 — see fleet/watchdog/watchdog-lib.sh for the grammar):
#   name  kind  alive_probe  freshness_probe  freshness_ttl_s  restart_cmd  owner
# restart_cmd runs as ROOT, cwd=/, no login shell. fleet/watchdog/verify-restart-cmds.sh is the
# HARD PRE-ENABLE GATE on this column: no quotes, no ~/$HOME, no `systemctl --user`, no sudo,
# every command word an ABSOLUTE path, ssh legs with -i/BatchMode/UserKnownHostsFile/user@host.
# Edit THIS file, then re-run generate-monit-config.sh — never hand-edit monit.d/*.conf.
# RETIRED 2026-08-03 (operator): grader-daemon deregistered and killed. It ran 10 days
# and last wrote model-scorecard.tsv on 08-02 11:32 (~36h idle) while the eval system is
# under repair and its grades are explicitly untrusted. Left registered it would be
# restarted by the watchdog on the 5400s scorecard-freshness window. See DECISIONS.md.
